display.title: Display language
display.description: Choose the UI language. “Follow browser” uses the language detected from your browser (it may change with the browser or OS). When signed in, the choice is stored in this browser only.
display.label: UI language

aiForm.title: My AI configuration
aiForm.intro: Per-user API key, URL, and model for the AI assistant and operations chat.
aiForm.contextHelp: Max characters; 0 = unlimited, up to 8 MB (8388608)
aiForm.autoApproveLabel: If enabled, the AI can call tools without confirmation
aiForm.visionHelp: When checked, uploaded images are inlined as OpenAI image_url for the vision model. If off, images are not inlined; the model may use read_chat_attachment for base64 instead (use when the model or gateway has no multimodal support).
aiForm.outputLocaleHelp: Used when a single message is too short or the language cannot be detected; empty uses site settings and UI locale. Explicit user language requests always win.
aiForm.agentHint: Max tool/think steps per turn; 0/empty uses global default (default {{def}}, cap {{cap}}).
aiForm.assistantEnabledLabel: After each main reply, a secondary assistant decides whether to continue (see max rounds below)
aiForm.assistantEnabledHelp: When off: tools may still run up to “Max agent steps” in one turn, but no new turn starts until the user sends another message.
aiForm.assistantHint: Consecutive assistant rounds (auto-continue); 0/empty uses global default (default {{def}}, cap {{cap}}).

mail.title: My outgoing mail
mail.intro: Use your own SMTP to send mail (e.g. AI reports, scheduled job notifications). This is separate from the system SMTP in “Global settings”. Verification codes and system notifications still use the admin SMTP. Off by default; fill in all fields before enabling.
mail.enableLabel: When enabled, “Send mail” and scheduled notifications use the SMTP below
mail.passwordPh: Leave empty to keep the saved password
mail.tlsSslHelp: Mutually exclusive: SSL (TLS from connect on 465) vs STARTTLS (upgrade on 587). If neither, plain text—test networks only.

search.title: Search (GitHub, Aliyun IQS, …)
search.intro: Web and code search for the AI. Each service’s API key is stored per user; search_web / search_github use them automatically. No key means disabled. GitHub can work without a PAT; IQS needs a personal key.
search.noProviders: No search services are registered yet.
search.enableLabel: Enable this search provider (if unchecked, the AI will not use it even with a key).

apiAccess.title: API access tokens
apiAccess.intro: For third parties (automation, OpenClaw, etc.) to call Moso over HTTP with your current role and data scope. Send Authorization: Bearer <token>. Each token’s plaintext is shown only once; revoke and recreate if lost.

mailStatus.incomplete: Status: “send mail” is on but the configuration is incomplete. Fill server, port, username, password, and From, then save again.
mailStatus.disabled: Status: mail sending is off. Complete the SMTP form, then enable “Enable mail sending”.
mailStatus.loadFailed: Could not load mail settings. Try again or check you are signed in.

github.description: Search repositories, code, issues, and users via the GitHub REST API. Works without a token (60 req/h); with a personal access token (PAT), 5,000 req/h and private repo access.

api_key.label: Personal Access Token (PAT)
api_key.help: Optional. Create at https://github.com/settings/tokens. For public content, public_repo is enough; for private repos, use repo.

iqs.description: Alibaba Cloud Information Query Service (UnifiedSearch) for open-domain web search. Configure an API key in the Alibaba Cloud console (service must be enabled).

api_key.label: IQS API key
api_key.placeholder: Create in Alibaba Cloud IQS console (~5 min to take effect)
api_key.help: Enable the service and create a key: https://help.aliyun.com/zh/document_detail/2872258.html. Each user configures their own key; there is no shared key.

default_engine_type.label: Default engine type
default_engine_type.help: Used when a call does not specify an engine. GenericAdvanced is billed by usage.

trial.ownKey: ✅ Using your own model config: you configured your own API key or a local/dedicated Base URL (e.g. Ollama). Moso does not count your usage against the shared key quota.
trial.sharedExhausted: ❌ Shared key quota used up ({{used}} / {{limit}}). Enter your own Base URL, API key, and model below to remove the limit, or ask an admin to reset the quota or set system defaults.
trial.sharedOk: 💡 Shared key quota: {{used}} / {{limit}} used, {{remaining}} left. Add your own key to remove the limit (Moso stops counting your usage).

prompts.newApiToken: Copy and store the full token now (it will not be shown again after you close this):
prompts.deleteAccountPassword: Enter your current password to verify:
prompts.deleteAccountTypeDelete: Final step: type the word DELETE in capitals to confirm

danger.title: ⚠️ Danger zone — delete account
danger.intro: Deleting your account permanently removes all of the following:
danger.li1: All hosts, credentials, host groups, and host tags you created;
danger.li2: Hosts you shared with others will be revoked from their accounts, and their chats, host knowledge, prompts, tags, and channels tied to those hosts are removed too;
danger.li3: All of your AI chats and messages (global, local, host), personal AI config, shared-key usage, API tokens, personal mail settings, triggers, schedules, and batch jobs;
danger.adminOnly: Admin accounts cannot be deleted here. Ask another admin to remove you in User management (so the last admin is never removed).

admin.userAiIntro: Set AI provider and model for any user, or copy system defaults to a user.
admin.applySystem: Apply system default to this user
admin.visionHelp: If off, images are not inlined as image_url; the model may use read_chat_attachment for base64 instead.
admin.notifyFeedbackIntro: When on, each new user feedback emails all admin addresses via system SMTP (at most once per 30 seconds to reduce noise).
admin.notifyFeedbackCode: If smtp_host is not set in global settings below, this has no effect.
admin.notifyFeedbackCheck: Notify admins when new feedback arrives
admin.credentialsVaultIntro: When enabled, users can save sudo / SSH / MySQL passwords via AI tools and REST API (not readable back), and send_service_password injects them when a password prompt appears. Off by default.
admin.credentialsVaultHint: See service-credentials.md. When off, related AI tools are hidden; saved data is kept.
admin.emailTemplatesIntro: For lock / unlock / suspend / restore. Subject is fixed as “Moso”. Body can use {{username}} for the account name.
admin.lockBodyPh: Hello {{username}}, your Moso account is locked...
admin.loginAnnouncementIntro: Shown at the top-right of the login page. Leave empty to hide it. Markdown is supported.
admin.loginAnnouncementPh:
Example: ### Maintenance
The system may be briefly unavailable from 22:00 to 23:00 tonight.
admin.loginAnnouncementAiHint: Admin AI can also update key: login_announcement_md
